past.title: Colonial Car Scene Meet | June 12th
past.body:
(Weekly) Colonial Car Scene Meet

Friday, June 12th | 7-10p

Located at Bruster's Real Ice Cream, 5289 John Tyler Hwy., Williamsburg.

FRIDAY! FRIDAY! FRIDAY! Friday nights, come on out and have a good time, trying get the dust off the camera with the sun being out for a good bit at the start and need some new photos for the flyers. As always respect the spot, it's been weeks since I've been able to come out and don't want to show up just to see some ding dongs being ding dongs ruining it.

Keep in mind that being around in ice cream establishment there are going to be children so please remain respectful! Hope to see you all out there this week.

No Revving - No Burnouts - No Loud Music. Pick-up after yourself. Hope to see you all there. 

Listing is provided by our Partnership with Don Pablo presents Car Crazy in Tidewater!

past.title: Thursday Night Cruise-In at the DQ | June 11th
past.body:
(Weekly) Thursday Night Cruise-In at the DQ

Thursday, June 11th | 3p

Located at Dairy Queen - 4024 Portsmouth Blvd., Chesapeake

So if you're not doing anything on Thursday afternoons get those cars out and come up to DQ. You can go in and order food and bring it out to eat. Make sure you bring a chair because they've taken the tables and chairs in. People start getting there around 2:00 and hang out for 3-4 hours or so. The weather is starting to get nice and there's not a whole lot of places we can go. This is one of the few places we can.

past.title: Topless Tuesdays | June 2nd
past.body:
(Every other tues) Topless Tuesdays

Tuesday, June 2nd | 5:30p-9p

Located at Garage Brewery | 1011 Eden Way, Chesapeake

Calling all Jeep owners & lovers! (O|||||||O)

This event is FREE & open to the public!
Every other Tuesday from 5:30-9pm
Jeepers get 10% OFF their tab!
Rotating Jeeps get entered to win an opportunity to park INSIDE our taproom!
Line up on our grass along Eden Way; overflow can go into a parking space.
Food Trucks rotate weekly, check our “Weekly Lineup” on IG or FB, our surrounding events here on FB, or on garage-brewery.com under “EVENTS”

Rain or Shine!
We won't judge if you aren't.. Topless

Listing is provided by our Partnership with Don Pablo presents Car Crazy in Tidewater!

past.title: Auto Club Meetup | May 23rd
past.body:
(Twice Weekly) Auto Club Meetup by the Retired Cruisers Club of America

Saturday, May 23rd | 7-10p

Located at 1400 S. Independence Blvd., Virginia Beach.

Hello auto family. Come out to Freedom Wash in VB for Friday and Saturday car meets. We think it will be cool to meet people in the Norfolk And Virginia beach area with ex police vehicles and some nice Hot Rodz. All different rides are welcome. Get a wash for only $5 and get a spot for you ride if you're looking to sell quick.  We are trying to recruit new members as well and we would love to get some new  supporters to help get The R.C.C name out there. if interested plz drop pic of your ride or hit us up - TY. 

Listing is provided by our Partnership with Don Pablo presents Car Crazy in Tidewater!

past.title: Fourth Annual Spring Car Show | May 16th, 2026
past.body:
Fourth Annual Spring Car Show

Saturday, May 16th, 2026 | 10a-3p

Located at Real Life Church | 900 Centerville Turnpike N, Chesapeake, VA 23320

Mark your 2026 calendars! – Real Life Christian Church and Rummel’s Automotive will be hosting our FOURTH Annual Spring Car Show on Saturday, May 16 at Real Life Church in Chesapeake, VA. Our shows always fill our parking lot with fantastic cars and friendly people. Our Spring ‘26 event will once again feature music, food, vendors, raffles, giveaways and we’ll be awarding LOTS of trophies among all vehicle types. More details to follow in upcoming months, but be sure to plan on coming to our Fourth Annual show on May 16th!

seoData.seoTitle: Fourth Annual Spring Car Show | May 16th, 2026
